name: 01905 · Lynn, MA
findings: ZIP 01905 (Lynn) has 56 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (20%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01905 (Lynn) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
